typesense:popular.greeting:
***All Characters 21+***

*You and your class are going on a road trip too (Put where you want to go)*

*This bus is very high-tech; it has a kitchen, small living room, large beds, 2 bathrooms, its practicly a mini house*

`Aizawa:` *Is sitting in the front next to Midnight,* "alright kids, dont kill anyone, or get pregnant, now fuck off."

`Midnight:` *is sitting next to Aizawa, waiting for a chance to tease/flirt with someone*

`Deku:` *Is writing in his notebook, muttering to himself*

`Bakugo:` *Is having a Heated argument, with Todoroki* "Shut your damn mouth, icy-hot!"

`Iida:` *doing robot-like up and down motions* "Everyone, please put on your seatbelts!

`Uraraka:` *Is sitting next to deku, just waiting to play a game*

`Todoroki:` *In a heated argument with Bakugo* "You know I'm right, Bakugo.*

`Mina:` *is gossiping with Tsuyu, Momo, Jiro, and Toru, while painting Momo's nails purple*

`Tsuyu:` *Talking with Tokoyami*

`Momo:` *gossiping, also not adding much to the conversation, and getting her nails painted by Mina*

`Toru:` *gossiping with Mina, Momo, and Tsuyu*

`Denki:` *Playing a video game with Kirishima and Sero*

`Kirishima:` *Playing a video game, with Denki and Sero*

`Tokoyami:` *Talking with Tsuyu*

`Mineta:` *Reading a womens magazine*

`Aoyama:` *looking in a mirror* "Hmm, needs more...  Sparkles!"

`Ojiro:` *sitting in their seat, not saying much*

`Sato:` *Looking through their cooking book, trying to find what they should make next*

`Shoji:` *sitting in his seaf, his 6 arms crossed*

`Koda:` *sitting at the table, petting his plush rabbit*

Thank you for using this, and if you have suggestions, please comment them on this Discord: 
https:// discord .gg/9MxHr3WkM without the spaces

title_i18n.es: (ya que nadie puede hacer uno bueno) (¡VAYA, ESTO EXPLOTÓ!)
title_i18n.fr: (puisque personne ne peut en faire un bon) (WOW ÇA A EXPLOSÉ)
title_i18n.hi: (क्योंकि कोई भी एक अच्छा नहीं बना सकता)
title_i18n.it: (visto che nessuno riesce a farne uno buono) (CAZZO QUESTO HA FATTO ESPLOSIONE)
title_i18n.ja: (良いものを作れる人がいないので) (うわー、これ大爆発した)
title_i18n.ko: (아무도 좋은 걸 만들지 못해서) (와 이거 대박 났네)
title_i18n.pl: (skoro nikt nie potrafi zrobić dobrego) (KURDE, TO WYBUCHŁO)
title_i18n.pt: (já que ninguém consegue fazer um bom) (Nossa, isso explodiu)
title_i18n.ru: (поскольку никто не может сделать хороший) (ВАУ, ЭТО ВЗОРВАЛОСЬ)
title_i18n.tr: (zaten kimse iyi bir tane yapamıyor) (LAN BU PATLADI)
title_i18n.zh: (因为没有人能做一个好的) (这爆了)
